app.title: audition
run.skipTitle: Move on without a note; this voice comes back on the next run (n)
run.last: the last voice in this run
run.solo: no reference on this page — say how it sounds on its own
run.wait.rendering: rendering this voice as it ships now
run.wait.failed: this voice could not be rendered
run.wait.done: every voice has a current verdict
run.why.rendering: The page on disk plays an older voice than the one that ships, so it is rendered again before you hear it.
run.why.done: A voice comes back here on its own once it changes. Voices skipped in this tab return when the tab is reopened.
run.noQueue: the queue could not be read: {msg}
opt.matchLoudness: match the loudness of the versions
opt.restart: restart from the top when I switch
keys.title: keyboard
keys.drag: Drag across a picture to mark a passage — play stays inside it, and loop repeats it. A click seeks; a click outside the passage leaves it. Drag the playhead itself to scrub.
pick.legend: The bar is how far the calibration has got. A number is how many listening notes it has; empty means nobody has listened yet.
pick.structure.long: the structural residual has been diagnosed
pick.music.long: somebody listened and said it is the instrument
pick.stale: stale — the voice moved under it
scope.instrument.long: the same voice with the bank’s rig cleared — where the instrument itself stops
compare.label: comparison
compare.instrument_di.long: the voice’s direct output, rig cleared and GS sends at zero, against a direct-input recording of the instrument
compare.gm_gs_product.long: the default playback, bank rig and GS effects included, against the slot’s GM/GS reference
compare.noReference: no reference has been captured for this comparison yet
path.label: path
path.sends.pre_rig: sends taken here, before the rig
path.sends.zero: sends at zero (no reverb or chorus)
path.changes: the path changes during this take, at {at} (showing {i} of {n})
path.legacy: this page was rendered before renders carried evidence
role.reference.long: reference — what it is being compared against
role.comparison.long: comparison — a capture offered beside the reference, not instead of it
id.noPolicy: no policy for this slot outside the repository
id.blindHidden: what answers it is hidden while blind
slot.gm.long: GM {gm}: a GM Level 1 sound, the GS capital tone at bank 0
slot.gs.long: a GS variation tone under GM {gm}, Bank Select MSB {bank}
slot.gm2.long: the GM2 address of a variation under GM {gm}, Bank Select LSB {bank}; the same patch as GS {alias}
slot.kit.long: a rhythm-part kit on channel 10; kit 0 is the GM standard kit
method.physical.long: computed from a model of how the instrument makes sound — engine {engine}
method.classic.long: oscillator waveforms, filtered (subtractive) or summed as partials (additive) — engine {engine}
method.physical.legend: physical model — the instrument’s mechanics, computed
tgt.default: a recording of the real instrument
tgt.machine_defined: the module’s own sound — one the machine invented
tgt.answers_a_different_instrument: the module — the library holds another instrument here
tst.aimed.long: the captured reference is the kind of source this slot is aimed at
tst.off-target.long: the captured reference is not the kind of source this slot is aimed at
tst.unclassified.long: the capture does not say what kind of source answered it
tst.declined.long: the policy holds that no recording carries this slot’s tone
tst.uncaptured.long: nothing has been captured for this slot yet
ship.current.long: the render’s bank is today’s for every unit it is made of
ship.stale.long: the voice moved after this render, so the page plays an older voice
ship.unverified.long: the render recorded no bank digest, or a shared engine unit moved since
ship.checking.long: the committed bank registries are still being read
ship.none.long: no unmodified render or no versioned unit to compare
ship.rerenderTitle: render this voice again to hear what ships
now.is.candidate.long: a recorded calibration setting heard on top of the shipped voice; it is not in the library
now.is.target.long: the reference this voice is being fitted to
now.is.context.long: another capture of the instrument, heard beside the target rather than as it
subj.declined: the map names this slot {names}; the recordings hold {carries} here
prov.offTarget: not what this slot is aimed at
prov.unclassified: the capture does not say what answered it
cmp.label: compared against:
cmp.unplayedTitle: No reference or comparison has been selected in this set yet.
cmp.manualTitle: Set by hand, overriding the last one selected.
cmp.autoTitle: The last reference or comparison version selected.
cmp.overrideTitle: If the last one selected is not what this note is about, name it here.
cmp.unknownTitle: This note predates recording what it was judged against.
ver.hint: Versions of the same take, to be chosen between — the line above says what the selected one is meant to sound like.
ver.baselineDesc: The library with no overrides, down the path that ships: the bank’s rig and the GS effects included.
ver.baselineDirectDesc: The same unmodified voice with the rig and the GS sends taken off — the instrument alone. What ships puts the rig after it.
ver.hintModel: Candidates — pick the one CLOSEST TO THE REFERENCE, which is not always the one you like most.
ver.hintModelAlone: No reference for this slot, so there is nothing to be near: pick the one that could pass for the real instrument.
ver.hintReference: The target itself, not candidates: several recordings of the instrument this slot is aimed at.
ver.hintComparison: Not the target and not a candidate: another capture of the same instrument, offered for context.
ver.hintDirect: The same settings with the rig cleared. A path to hear them down, not another set to choose from.
ver.hintBlind: Names hidden. Switching decides nothing — answer each take with “this one” or “could not tell”.
now.copyTitle: Set, take, version, playhead, which strike it is in, and the link that reproduces it
transport.rewindTitle: To the start of the marked passage, or of the take when none is marked
transport.loopTitle: Repeat the marked passage, or the whole take when none is marked
wave.caption: waveform — every version drawn in its own colour, the one sounding solid
spec.caption: spectrogram of the version sounding — log frequency
takes.title: takes
blind.pickEach: decide each take, or say you could not tell
blind.chooseTitle: Record the version sounding as this take’s answer. Switching between versions does not decide anything.
blind.unsureTitle: Record that this take could not be separated. That is a result about the voice, not a missing answer.
blind.refDi: blind listening is off for this voice: its reference is a direct-input recording, and the blind draw would compare the amplified model against it
blind.unmatched: blind listening is off for this comparison: {status}, so a ranking would not be about the voice
fb.title: tell me what you hear
fb.intro: Two choices at a time, and “not sure” is an answer. Send at any point.
fb.comment: anything else, in your own words
fb.attach: attach what is sounding right now
fb.attachWhat: take, version, playhead, which strike, and the options in force
fb.preferTitle: Record this version as the one to keep, with what is sounding and whatever is in the box below
fb.recent: what has been said about this voice
fb.needSomething: Answer something or write a line first.
fb.stale: Not sent: the set was rendered again after this page read it ({reason}). Your text is kept; reload the set and send again.
bank.notGenerated: No bank view generated. Run `make voice-status-refresh` (it needs a -DBUILD_TUNING=ON build) and reload.
bank.selectOne: Select a voice for its coverage and where it sits against the references’ own spread.
stage.0.of: no deliberate patch: a famN family fallback on subtractive
stage.1.of: a deliberate engine and patch answer it
stage.2.of: two or more reference timbres, a profile, a current gate
stage.3.of: every canonical dimension gated, or excused with a reason
stage.4.of: most gated dimensions sit inside the reference spread
stage.5.of: no structural residual, and the musical take signed off
empty.noRenders: No renders found. Generate a set with tools/voicematch/make_audition.py — --model-only needs no plugin — then reload.
tree.off.q: Compared with the reference, how is it?
tree.off.qSolo: How does this sound to you?
tree.off.ok: This is fine as it is
tree.grade.q: Does it hold up as the instrument it is meant to be?
tree.grade.acceptable: It is the instrument — not the reference, but I could live with it
tree.grade.wrong-instrument: No — it sounds like something else
tree.broken.broken: Barely, or it dies away to nothing
tree.broken.wrong-instrument: It sounds, it is just the wrong sound
tree.alien.wrong-instrument/other: An instrument, but the wrong one
tree.when.q: What draws your attention — the moment it starts, or while it sounds?
tree.body.q: Is it how the note dies away, or its colour?
tree.tone.q: Which way is the colour off?
